newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond futures start below GLOBEX high.
newsitem.headline: French bond futures start below GLOBEX high.

text.p: 0633 GMT - Sept bond futures start slightly lower but near contract high. Strong resistance above 129.92, contract high, seen at 130.18. Support put around 129.72 and then 129.52. Open interest fell slightly during Thursday's rally. Franc, PIBOR, 10-year Bund spread all stable. Little reaction to Prime Minister Lionel Jospin interview late on Thursday.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.50 pct vs 5.50. Bund spread -11 vs -10
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR unch 96.57
